author: liko265
quote: If the frame rate were not locked at 30 FPS, I would likely play this game more often. The characters were uninteresting, and I did not particularly enjoy the feminist themes presented. Given the $80–$100 price point, I do not believe it is currently worth the cost and would recommend waiting for a sell to happen or go in price in stores.
